meta.name: IITALY — warm paper, riso objects, Apple-style tiles
meta.description: The site's own design DNA, recorded with the design-dna skill (phase 2 on the live build) to steer a motion smoothing pass. Not a new direction: DESIGN.md stays the source of truth.
source_references: Screenshot of /guides at 1440px, measured with design-dna scripts/measure-colors.mjs (k=8)
Owner references: apple.com home tiles, iPhone lineup, «Learn all about» row

Owner references 3 Nov: apple.com/it/iphone-duo «First of all, the news» gallery (dots + play) and «iOS and Apple Intelligence» media row (mixed widths, caption under the frame, arrows); measured with measure-colors.mjs: background #fbfbfc 0.79, text #25282a 0.09 — structure adopted, Apple's cool palette not (warm paper stays)

Owner reference 3 Nov: Busy Bee Honey style reference (flat full-bleed colour bands, unframed centred product, marquee strips, pill-only shapes, one statement + one line + one action per block) — principles adopted in the IITALY palette; its colours and display serif are not

color.palette_type: warm neutral paper with one terracotta accent; illustrations bring teal, cream and tomato red

accent.role: calls to action, chosen answers, current step

neutral.usage: #F4F0E7 paper background; #2A2420 body text and dark tiles; mid tones for hairlines, notes and secondary text (all at least 4.5:1 for text)

color.contrast_strategy: Dark ink on warm paper, cream on dark tiles; terracotta fills carry cream text (5.4:1). No cold colours outside the allowlisted flight blue and success greens (design-warm-palette-review).

typography.font_style_notes: Tight negative tracking on headings, balanced wrapping; Onest uppercase with .06–.08em tracking for step counters and labels; no second typeface.

spacing.section_rhythm: one idea per tile or page; 12px between tiles, 28-52px inside them

layout.grid_system: CSS grid with subgrid for aligned card rows
layout.columns: 2 tiles on desktop, 1 below 760px; card rows scroll horizontally
layout.gutter: 12px between tiles, 16px page gutter on phones
layout.alignment_tendency: centred tiles and questions; left-aligned reading pages

shape.border_usage: hairlines #DCD3C3 and 1px terracotta outlines on capsules
shape.divider_style: thin solid or dotted warm rules

elevation.shadow_style: none on public surfaces since 3 Nov 2026 — level is colour (paper, white, cocoa band); the header keeps frosted material and an inner highlight
elevation.depth_cues: tone contrast between light and dark tiles, a 4px lift on hover, paper grain

easing.celebration: cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) — stamps and saved checks only

duration_scale.macro: 520ms (entrances, the plane, progress, deck swing up to 560-620ms)

motion.entrance_pattern: rise 8-16px with fade on the signature curve; staggers 30-40ms, never over 300ms in total; tiles rise with the scroll (translate only); carousels rise 40px into place on page scroll; autoplay advances one card per 5 s with a linear progress fill in the active dot
motion.exit_pattern: none — routes swap instantly and the new view enters
motion.philosophy: calm premium: decelerate into place, no overshoot in UI; reduced motion removes every movement

components.button_style: pills: filled terracotta or dark, outlined terracotta secondary; press scales to .97
components.input_style: rounded 14px fields on paper with a warm hairline
components.card_style: guide topics: unframed riso object on a full-bleed cocoa band (no card, no shadow), equal 340px slides, title / teaser / cream pill aligned across slides with subgrid; elsewhere flat white surfaces with a warm hairline
components.navigation_pattern: top bar with four sections; breadcrumbs on guide pages; guides directory is a gallery with dots + play (5 s per card), section pages a row with previous/next arrows; dots and previous/next cards on step pages
components.modal_style: rare; comparison opens in a dialog with a warm scrim
components.component_notes: carousels bleed to the window edges with the first card on the text column; nothing runs above the guide band; one 1216px column for home, guides index and footer; the cabinet overview is a stack of 28px tiles with 12px gaps like the apple.com home (hero «Now» tile, dark route board, 2×N grid of light/dark tiles with a studio-rendered object each)

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a travel notebook: paper, stamps, a flight plan
aesthetic.era_influence: Apple product pages meeting 1970s risograph print

visual_language.ornamentation: one riso object per topic or question
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: centred, heavy headline over light answers
visual_language.contrast_level: high for text, soft for surfaces

composition.flow_direction: top to bottom; card rows left to right
composition.negative_space_role: gives each question room to breathe

imagery.illustration_style: risograph objects: teal, cream and tomato red with navy outlines, transparent background, no text or people

interaction_feel.feedback_style: quiet fills and a small check
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: 4px lift, terracotta fill on capsules, object drifts up
interaction_feel.loading_style: skeleton-free; the plane travels and Vespi checks documents

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: say what to add and where, no fake buttons
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: calm and specific, with the next step

overview.fallback_strategy: everything works static; prefers-reduced-motion removes movement; scroll-driven effects only with @supports

background_effects.description: SVG feTurbulence grain at 6% multiplied over the warm paper

3d_elements.description: only a CSS perspective arc on comparison posters

params.interaction_model: focus a poster to straighten it

scroll_triggered_animations.trigger_points: view() entry 0-70% for tiles, entry 15% to cover 45% for objects
scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: fade-free rise (translate) and slight scale for objects

marquee.description: removed 3 Nov (owner: «убери эти символы наверху»): nothing runs above the guide band

text_effects.description: text never animates by letter; whole blocks rise on entrance

image_effects.description: riso objects drift up 6px and grow 2% on hover; rise with the scroll

glassmorphism_neumorphism.style: one soft fog at the bottom of the cabinet timeline

svg_animations.description: code-drawn porthole with a slow cloud drift and a lifting shade; the plane rides the flight line

visual_effects.composite_notes: Effects stay small so content leads. Motion identity: one signature curve, three durations, one entrance pattern (see design_system.motion and DESIGN.md «Motion identity»).
